svg.title: Two parallax bands asking one plane cell with world origins 512 pixels apart (synthetic schematic)
svg.text: One plane cell, two answers (synthetic schematic; no game data)
screen (320 px picture, margins left and right)
band A: lines 0-39, hscroll 0, world origin 1024
band B: lines 40-79, hscroll 419, world origin 1117
one 8-line plane-cell row straddles the boundary of A and B
plane x = screen x - hscroll (what the host looks up, unwrapped)
line in B: left-margin cell -13..-1 (asked by another line)
The host asks the SAME plane cell (c, r) for both lines.
ABI 1 answered each ask with its own world cell: c + 128 for A and c + 192 for B (64 cells = 512 px apart).
An ABI 2 window holds ONE word per plane cell, so one of the two answers cannot be expressed.
